name: Kisetsu no Hanayome
source:
Kise, the protagonist, is an orphan who lives happily with his adopted family: his older sister Natsumi, his mother Asuka, and his younger sister Hazuna.

One day, at the traditional festival in the village, he meets a mysterious girl in the hills of the village, Maki, a girl without memories who wants nothing else but to become his bride. 

[Shortly translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=32846]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
主人公季濑是一名孤儿，与收养他的家人幸福地生活在一起：姐姐夏美、母亲明日香，以及妹妹叶月。

一天，在村里的传统祭典上，他在山丘间遇见一名神秘少女真希。她失去了记忆，唯一的愿望就是成为他的新娘。

[简译自[url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=32846]Getchu[/url]]
